title: Can I get a slop analysis from not AI?
author: Psychological-Ad9408
selftext:
So I started a project with a one-shot prompt from Fable and slowly developed it more to be more of a game. Sadly, I am still not getting enough engagement or gameplays. I am torn between 1) it's a bad / boring game 2) poor marketing 3) recognized as AI slop. And while I am trying to do something about the first 2, I realized maybe I am not also good to recognize the last one. When I do get feedback, they just say it's good, but clearly they're a minority and the majority is just getting ignored, which is worse that bad feedback.

Can someone point out either my game, store descriptions, trailers that look like slop? I am even opting for just game screenshots since I cannot make any art, but maybe even the game screens look like slop. 

I am at a loss here and am hoping for some clarity. 

My Itch link is https://shoogar.itch.io/velocity-midnight-run

Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/5023550/Velocity\_\_Midnight\_Run/

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body:
would you be interested in these kind of reviews? [https://youtu.be/MLNXZd5IZTE](https://youtu.be/MLNXZd5IZTE)

I have a backlog right now but let me know, thanks

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body: I do the reviews but I left the video composition/editing to AI. it is mostly just a first impression review from another dev

comments.author: Significant_Tell407
comments.body: I mean the game looks fine but its not really anything new? Why would I play this when I could play Need for Speed, Forza, Mario Kart etc. This is what I tell every AI developer. The most important thing is your competitive advantage? What does you game have that other racing games don't? If you cant answer this question then that is in fact the answer to your post

replies.author: Psychological-Ad9408
replies.body:
I guess that is under bucket 1). I started the project when the trend was saying there are no longer racing games with the sense of speed as NFS had, and EA declared NFS dead. So I guess in a sense feeding the same experience that NFS did long before is not enough competitive advantage? 

My other answer would have been lightweight and portability. I played FH6 and other AAA titles but my free time was over by time the loading screen ended and I got into a race. It's also cross-platform with browser and later Android and iOS releases... If it got traction. 

I appreciate you calling me out on that and I hope to know your advice on this.

comments.author: Kingnorik
comments.body: Why would I play it what's different from the millions of car racing games vying for my attention? You guys love giving steam $100.

replies.author: Psychological-Ad9408
replies.body:
Well, primarily is I hope you found it fun enough to spend time on. So I guess I would say the problem is under bucket 2) if I was able to give you enough reasons to try it for 5 minutes? I do see your point that there are so many racing games now, and I've been finding more since I started looking into the competition, I still thought I filled in a niche experience. I'd like to think at least. 

Let me know if it's very vanilla compared to other racers.

replies.author: Kingnorik
replies.body: It's just that when people play racers, they have a lot of good options now a days. I like playing sims, with an occasional forza depending on the graphics. So to even try a racing game I'd need that level of polish. What is your game trying to do differently. It looks like low poly nfs most wanted. And it's like why would I play that when I can play nfs most wanted?

replies.author: Psychological-Ad9408
replies.body: I guess was looking to fit the niche of more later games out now versus what there is as a whole. Before the project, I never realized people still play the old titles. I didn't know Hot Pursuit was still active online. When you say polish though, I guess you expect the level of triple A realism out there, right?

replies.author: Kingnorik
replies.body: Car feelings, like a mustang feels different from a Porsche even in arcadey games. With AI car profiles should be really easy to implement. You don't even have to go real research. I've thought of making an AI racing game and maybe will eventually.

replies.author: Psychological-Ad9408
replies.body:
Yeah, I just had to tell AI that axle physics should be separated between front and back to bring out FWD vs RWD vs AWD. We were even able to bring in weight distribution for front vs mid engines. 

The way the frontier models are going, you could probably do it faster with better quality when you do make one. 

I appreciate you taking the time on this.

comments.author: Csilo
comments.body:
Skimmed through the Steam page. The game's visuals look dull. Having such a simple graphic one would guess it would run at least fine but the trailer looks laggy. 

And tbh there's nothing that would make me want to try it. There's not a twist, it look like yet another arcade racing game. Something that you would see played free with ads on Android. Have you tried asking yourself why should anyone pay for this when you can play any other racing game? What makes it different?

replies.author: Psychological-Ad9408
replies.body:
I was hoping the primary reason is it's fun. But I do see where you're coming from that the store shots and descriptions are dull. At least that under bucket 2). I guess I'll continue to work on marketing skills or some artistic direction of it. I'll start with a re-shot trailer.

Thanks for your honesty. I appreciate it.

comments.author: shlaifu
comments.body: looks like someone's first game, made following a tutorial. what are you expecting?

comments.author: Ok-Investment4414
comments.body:
as a top 1% commenter i deem thy offering...not...slop! 

![gif](giphy|H5C8CevNMbpBqNqFjl)

but also bruh cmon u have at least played need for speed , burn out or some other car game u know this ain't worth asking someone to pay for. We gotta work on the sound, the steering stiff af , with space grade steel these cars are made out of why bother even have crash mechanics if only slows us down. My time trial ghost thingies can go off screen , the other cars models are basic compared to what we can drive , the city :- / threejs can get u a better city . Aside from that its vanilla AF. 

Not sure it was u or ai but u got the steering wheel moving when we turn , those subtle things are what makes games worth playing and what makes your shit seem like effort was put in there.

replies.author: Psychological-Ad9408
replies.body:
Thank you for the seal of non-slop.

I did play NFS. I wanted to re-create the experience of NFSU of running 300kmh from a highway to an alleyway with the wind whooshing past. I wanted to re-create the police chases and weapons of Hot Pursuit. 

As for the steering and physics, I am a bit of a realist and it might be punishing, so I get that. I could allow different physics options like with steering and get that twist in the store fronts. 

I appreciate this!

comments.author: Kasonanvu
comments.body:
Hmmm does not look that slop like at all, but there's things to improve. 
Too dark, need more locations, needs some kind of post processing balancing, maybe fog, better shots for trailer

replies.author: Psychological-Ad9408
replies.body: I removed the fog because someone said it was too dark. Lol but as you said it's still too dark. Hmm what do you mean by post processing balance though?

comments.author: Longjumping_Wall9861
comments.body: Did not seem like AI slop to me but people also keep calling my game AI slop so I can't say I'm the expert. For a quick fun browser game it looks okay, had me playing for couple of minutes but I did not understand the goal. I later saw that I've a time to survive so the goal could be made more obvious maybe a small tutorial or campaign like structure. As a paid content, sadly I would not pay for the game. It might have interesting mechanics but I could not see them in the first couple of minutes.

replies.author: Psychological-Ad9408
replies.body:
Make the timer more obvious. Got it. I guess that should be front center rather than the survived time. I was hoping the core loop could draw in the attention before I let out the overall scheme of things, but I guess as far as racers go, the consensus is that it's pretty standard. I guess in a way, that's good because the base is fine, it just needs the juice. 

I appreciate you looking into this.

comments.author: Exhales_Deeply
comments.body:
i'm in with the 'too generic' crowd along with my own separate 'it would let me steer on my ipad' crowd. (itch demo)

It doesn't look terrible or slopfilled. it just gives a lot of 'meh' - and i'm not a big racing guy so take that with a grain of salt, this might really scratch a specific itch for someone but i guess i'd challenge you to figure out what itch that is and maximize it

may also wanna also run your VO elements through a bit of a compressor so they're audible on device speakers - the acting was swell, she just trailed off a bit at the end of some sentences

replies.author: Psychological-Ad9408
replies.body: Oh right. Playing on iOS is hard with the on-screen search that I could not get around. Yeah, the general consensus is too generic, which I am glad I finally got out so I know what to work on. I appreciate you looking into it and I'll look into the VO volumes.

comments.author: Little_Grimmy_Reap
comments.body:
Not only does this seem like a 0.25 cent arcade racer, it doesn’t even have cars based in real life. Half the fun of racing games is to drive your favorite cars. But these slop cars aren’t even recognizable. Do you even like cars??

I saw you mentioned you have trouble distinguishing slop from not, but this is ridiculous dude come on 

If you don’t know what makes a racing game a good racing game, don’t make one because it’s super derivative. I’m all for ai game development but this example is embarrassing

comments.author: Ill-Past4609
comments.body:
Only because I spot AI, from a mile away but people who don’t do aigamedev or Vibecoding wouldn’t tell the different. Also a little piece of advise never one shot prompt a game they have no soul instead

Think of a game idea design the following   
Game design document bible  
Art style guide bible  
Core loop mechanic, end game bible

And start from their.

Create the core loop first and work your way out.
